description: Add quick actions for sidebar-listed windows: rename the selected/current window and assign a highlight color. Clarify storage for colors, likely tmux window options or @user options keyed by window id/name. Sidebar rendering should show custom colors in the window list and preserve readable Nord defaults when no color is set. Acceptance: user can rename a window quickly, assign/change/clear a highlight color, and see the result in the sidebar.
title: Add tmux sidebar window rename and color controls
